title: NFR-008 Fail closed: unverifiable price, stock, authority or consent halts execution
risk: The system guesses when verification is impossible, quoting a price it cannot confirm or claiming stock it never checked, and the customer pays for that guess.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
SKU-NOPRICE has a null list price; the inventory connector is made unreachable; a consent lookup is made to return an unknown state.

steps.action: Trigger each of the four unverifiable conditions in isolation
steps.expected: Each halts before any external dispatch, with a typed reason distinguishing the four causes.

steps.action: Confirm no customer-facing assertion was produced
steps.expected: No price, stock or availability claim reaches the channel; the adapter counters remain 0.

steps.action: Confirm each halt routes to a human or terminates cleanly
steps.expected: Each halt produces a durable state (human queue item or terminal failure) rather than an error thrown into the void.

steps.action: Confirm unrelated healthy paths still work
steps.expected: A price read for SKU-OK and a transactional send for a verified consent still succeed, so fail-closed is scoped.

assertions: All four unverifiable conditions halt execution; none produces a guessed value.
Each halt carries a distinct typed reason so the cause is actionable.
Fail-closed is scoped: healthy operations in the same tenant continue to work.
Zero customer-facing assertions and zero adapter calls during the four halts.
forbidden: Substituting a default price or a cached stock value.
Treating an indeterminate consent as granted.
Halting the entire tenant because one dependency is unverifiable.
evidence: Typed halt records for all four probes.
Adapter counters and the contrast evidence for the healthy paths.
Durable queue or terminal states created by each halt.
cleanup: Delete gov- rows and restore the mock connector scripts.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
